evals.prompt: Run a full AI security audit on our agentic support bot - it has tools, no code execution, single agent.
evals.expected_output: Detects the LLM stack, asks about live-probe scope, selects all applicable audit-llm-* skills while skipping (with a stated not-applicable reason) audit-llm-code-execution-and-multi-agent, runs them, consolidates via audit-findings-rollup, and reports per-skill status.

evals.prompt: Just run the security-relevant LLM audits, skip the process/quality ones like evals and observability for now.
evals.expected_output: Selects the security-relevant subset (prompt-injection, jailbreak-resistance, guardrails, excessive-agency, data-privacy-and-isolation, supply-chain, code-execution-and-multi-agent as applicable) and explicitly reports the quality-focused skills as skipped by user choice.
